D.D.C. · No. 1:20‑cv‑03010‑APM · E.D. Va. · No. 1:23‑cv‑00108‑LMB United States v. Google The federal government and groups of states sued Google twice. The first suit is about search and was filed in Washington in 2020. The second is about the technology that sells online ads and was filed in Virginia in 2023. In each one a judge found that Google broke antitrust law to keep a monopoly. What Google has to do about it is still being fought over. Search suit filed Oct 20, 2020 Ad tech suit filed Jan 24, 2023 Status Remedies and appeals
Plaintiff The side that sued Joined by groups of states in both suits
Defendant The side that was sued Search and advertising company, owned by Alphabet
